title: Education workers and students march in Tours
seoTitle: Tours education workers and students march

tea.why: Protesters marched to maintain pressure on the government amid widespread social anger over education policies and public sector conditions.
tea.want: Participants demanded improvements to salaries and career structures for national education personnel.
tea.changed: Nov 10: Around 1,000 protesters marched from place de la Liberté to place Anatole-France in Tours.

summary: On November 10, 2026, education workers, students, and high schoolers gathered in Tours for a demonstration called by an inter-union coalition. Marchers set off from place de la Liberté and headed toward place Anatole-France, demanding progress on salaries and careers for national education staff while maintaining pressure on the government. According to police estimates, about 1,000 people attended the demonstration, while union representatives claimed slightly higher numbers. The event followed previous larger mobilizations in early November and proceeded calmly, with younger participants leading the procession and chanting slogans.
organizers: intersyndicale de lycéens, d'étudiants et de professeurs
demands: Advances on salaries for national education personnel
Improvements to career structures for national education personnel
response: No official government counter-measure was reported in the sources regarding the march, which proceeded calmly.
